## Design

### 2026-10-25: I have been working on the KiCad schematics and correcting all  errors for my MIDI keypad, Vavavoom!

**4h**

I have been working on the KiCad schematics and correcting all  errors for my MIDI keypad, Vavavoom!

What I did: Connected the Waveshare ESP32-S3-Zero microcontroller, switches, rotary encoder, and touch pads. Corrected the power errors by placing a PWR_FLAG on the 3V3 net, as well as learning how to use the proper -Switch variant on the rotary encoder footprint.

Problem:KiCad was giving me errors regarding the footprint not being correct and the wrong switch pads for the encoder and I noticed I used the wrong footprint without switch so I used the correct Alps EC11 switch footprint in the footprint editor to get the pins lined up properly.
Next I'll be designing the 7-pad capacitive touch strip footprint and PCB!

### 2026-10-25: Project Objective: Finalized the custom capacitive touch interface for the vavavoom, replicating the "piano key" aesthetic (L and T shapes) demonstrated in the project tutorial.   Design & Layout Exec

**9h**

Project Objective: Finalized the custom capacitive touch interface for the vavavoom, replicating the "piano key" aesthetic (L and T shapes) demonstrated in the project tutorial.   Design & Layout Execution:Successfully created custom touch pads (TOUCH1 through TOUCH7) using overlapping rectangular SMD building blocks to form the required L and T piano-key shapes.Resolved single-number mapping by assigning unassigned/blank secondary identifiers so that multi-part keys cleanly merge into a single electrical connection.Configured precise spacing and grid settings to maintain the recommended copper clearance and prevent short circuits.UI & Navigation: Reconciled KiCad version UI differences, including navigating the Footprint Editor back to the main PCB layout and managing the Appearance Manager panel.Current Status: The custom 7-key capacitive touch footprint is fully designed, verified, and correctly positioned on the PCB layout.
